<thought>Based on the observed isotopic envelope—dominant M peak, ~14 % M+1, ~1 % M+2, and rapidly decreasing higher peaks—the pattern matches the expected distribution for a molecule containing many carbon atoms (≈13 C). No characteristic M+2 ~33 % (Cl) or ~100 % (Br) patterns are present, and the M+2 intensity is far below the ~4 % expected for sulfur. Thus carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
